I'm wrapping up now: I'll keep the answer skimmable and put code references inline in backticks, since the code itself isn't needed here. The doc path goes last, right before the follow-up options, and I won't claim the provider types have their own doc beyond the architecture doc, since the Anthropic provider just lives in core under the Llm folder.

I'm settling on the doc to point to: the CLI doc at src/docs/projects/LouisAgent.Cli.md goes last, with ADR 0091 mentioned earlier in the text with its path.

I'm going through the host's pieces now: the web tools are only live if `WebAccess.Create` is passed in, traces need `OtlpTelemetry.Instance`, and the providers are the model connections the page names. The program itself carries no agent logic, since the core ships none, and I'll cite the ADR 0091 path for that.

This `Program.cs` starts the coding agent's terminal host, and it contains no agent logic. It names what the agent loads, then hands that to `CliHost`.

The `using` lines bring in the framework's namespaces. `LouisAgent.Core.Web` and `LouisAgent.Core.Telemetry` are libraries on top of core, so a host must reference them to get web access and traces (ADR 0091).

The line that matters is the `await CliHost.RunAsync(...)` call. It takes three things:

- `args` is the command line. If you pass a prompt, `CliHost` answers that one prompt and exits. Otherwise it opens an interactive chat.
- `CodingCatalog.Create()` is the catalogue: the identities and packs the agent loads. Your program names them, because the CLI library can't reference another project's packs.
- `new HostServices(...)` lends the host the things the catalogue doesn't cover:
  - `WebAccess.Create` gives the agent its web tools. Without it, those tools report that web access isn't set up.
  - `OtlpTelemetry.Instance` sends the traces. Without it, nothing listens, and turns go unmeasured.
  - `Providers:` lists the model connections: Anthropic, Ollama and an OpenAI-compatible one.

To change what the agent is, you edit the catalogue. To change how it is hosted, you edit `HostServices`.

Source: `src/docs/projects/LouisAgent.Cli.md`, with the composition rule in `src/docs/adr/0091-web-access-and-telemetry-are-libraries-on-core.md`.
